scenario: AITA for playing videogames at 2AM on a Friday night. | Tldr: roommate calls me out for play video games at this time if the day. Little context, I live with 4 roommates, each have their own room. Most of them are pretty loud whenever they're home. I always play online videogames when I'm free. Especially these days. I was playing online to today with a couple of friends online. I am usually not very loud, but not very quiet either. Just like an average person having an average phone call. Is it moral to continue playing late but try to keep it quiet?
